route: cheap Lowlevel PrintWindow on a hidden desktop, installed v1.702.1, isolated profile with a neutral path
notes: Every frame is a 1920x1200 PNG of a 1280x800 DIP window at 150% scale.
privatePathVisible comes from a visible-text scan for the user name, user profile paths and AppData; the vault and profile use a neutral C:/MFE-Demo folder, so no frame shows a user name.
Server card tabs show a prepared Vanilla 26.3 server with the license not accepted; no license, start, stop, plugin or setting action was taken.
Home and Documentation are tall pages captured at the top, plus a scrolled Home frame.
Skipped: dark/bilingual force-lock confirm initially missed, then recaptured; nothing else skipped except actions that need license acceptance (server start/stop/restart/plugins).
